title: Larkspur — distributed job scheduling for Python
snippet: What Larkspur is: distributed job scheduler for Python. License: Apache 2.0. Maintainers: the Larkspur project core team, sponsored by Fennick Labs.

title: Installing Larkspur — Larkspur docs
snippet: Supported Python versions (3.10 to 3.13), installing with pip, extras for the Redis and Postgres backends and the dashboard.
